text:
maria: Quick sync — after the rate-tiering rollout yesterday I noticed some tenants got trimmed harder than expected. Thinking we need a recomposition pass for tenant thresholds that accounts for per-model budgets. Anyone else seeing skew?
kevin: yup saw that on prod-2 around 09:10, some medium tenants dropped to probational level. Suspect our smoothing window is too short when model-level caps kick in.
anna: I noticed a similar blip on the leaderboard service. Do we have a repro?
maria: repro steps: load test with mixed long/short sequences, enable new per-model budgets, watch reservoir drains. SmoothingWindow=30s currently.
kevin: initial theory: we compute tenant threshold as min(global, per-model-derived) without re-weighting for recent token distribution. That makes tenants serving heavy long-context models suddenly look more expensive and they get pushed down.
devon: would adding a weighted rolling average help? e.g. keep separate EWMA for model mix and combine?
anna: combining sounds right but need to be careful with fairness: smaller tenants shouldn't get permanently starved during transient model spikes.
maria: agree. Proposed approach: recomposition job every 5m that ingests per-tenant model mix histogram + recent latency/queue signals, emits adjusted thresholds with a decay factor.
kevin: 5m decent starting point. But need fast path for manual overrides/rollbacks (canary turned on/off). Also think we should mark recomposition outputs as provisional for the first N minutes.
anna: provisional outputs = good. The admission layer can treat provisional thresholds as lower-confidence and avoid hard evictions, instead prefer soft-shed or sample-based probation.
devon: telemetry ask: we need per-tenant model histograms, tokens-by-sequence-length percentiles, and per-tenant eviction counts. Can we add those to the metrics pipeline?
sre-bot: @maria created alert: tenant-eviction-rate spike > 0.5% for 5m on prod-2. Incident channel notified.
maria: thanks. I'll attach logs.
kevin: ops note: recomposition has to be idempotent and lock-free. We shouldn't take global locks across quota shards. Plan: emit delta updates to a versioned threshold table and let shards apply them via compare-and-swap.
anna: +1. Also store provenance: reason code = MODEL_MIX_SHIFT, inputs digest, recomposition version. Useful for rollbacks.
devon: edge-case: what if a tenant uses a new model unseen in historical histograms (cold model)? Recomposition should back off to conservative cap, not optimistic.
kevin: agree. Fallback policy: if model_identity not in histogram, treat as 2x cost factor until observed. Annotate as cold-model.
maria: can we run an experiment? Roll recomposition on 10% of tenants regionally, expose provisional thresholds via debug endpoint, and compare eviction/latency uplift.
anna: yes — rollout plan: (1) simulate on canary infra with replayed traces; (2) enable recomposition for 10% tenants in us-west; (3) monitor eviction-rate, p50/p95 latency, cost-per-token.
kevin: add a rapid rollback hook: recomposition toggles via feature flag + immediate fallback to previous version. Keep last 3 versions for quick restore.
devon: small implementation note: recomposition job should be cheap — do incremental updates only for tenants with > 1% model-mix change. Avoid recomputing everything every cycle.
maria: agreed. Also need an operator UI showing recomposition diffs and flags to mark a recomposition as bad.
anna: wishlist for the UI: tenant id, old_threshold, new_threshold, reason_code, inputs_digest, estimated cost delta, apply_time, author.
kevin: security note: ensure recomposition output doesn't leak model identities of other tenants — strip or hash model ids in public UI.
maria: good catch. Hashing model ids and only exposing if tenant opts-in.
sre-bot: @kevin created rollout job 621234: recomposition-canary started for us-west-10. See pipeline link: https://ci.internal/recomp/621234
kevin: I'll add the probe metrics. Also add a debug flag to force-provisional so admission logs include both candidate and applied thresholds for 1m window.
devon: quick proto for recomposition delta patch (psuedo):
```
for tenant in changed_tenants:
  current = read_threshold(tenant)
  candidate = recompute(tenant_hist)
  if abs(candidate - current) / current > 0.05:
    write_versioned_delta(tenant, candidate)
```
anna: keep 5% threshold for change noise gate, good start.
maria: timeline: spike fix hotpatch (if needed) today; prototype job + canary next week; UI follow-up after canary.
kevin: I'll own the job + compare-and-swap apply; devon take the metrics; anna build the UI skeleton; maria coordinate rollout.
anna: ack.
maria: thanks all — will drop the incident log and patch links here. :thumbsup:
